task.title: P6-179: Null-check btn in android-states-check.mjs page.evaluate
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-179. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**`btn` is dereferenced without a null check inside `page.evaluate`** in `end2end/android-states-check.mjs:138-146`, so a missing `state-retry` throws out of the probe instead of reporting `FAIL` (was `P6-012g`).
